freePlan.limits: SketchUp for Schools is free but requires a K-12 Google Workspace for Education or Microsoft Education account; not available to the general public.

keyLimits.en: Essential 3D design on iPad and web only, no desktop modeling; includes cloud storage, mobile viewer, real-time sharing.
Full toolkit including desktop modeling, LayOut documentation, and access to 1000+ extensions.
Advanced visualization and BIM workflows, including Revit importer and point-cloud modeling; restricted to Windows.

cautions.en: Prices shown are annual billing; a monthly (no-commitment) billing option exists but at a higher per-month rate than the annual-equivalent figures above.
The Go plan, the cheapest paid tier, does not include desktop modeling, so a freelancer needing full desktop functionality must buy Pro or Studio instead.

capabilities.en: 3D modeling for architecture, interior design and product design across desktop, web and mobile.
LayOut for producing construction/presentation documentation from 3D models (Pro/Studio).
Library of 1000+ extensions for specialized workflows (Pro/Studio).
Studio tier adds a Revit importer, point-cloud modeling and photorealistic rendering for BIM workflows.

limitations.en: Desktop modeling is unavailable on the entry-level Go plan (iPad/web only).
Studio, the tier with BIM/Revit interoperability and advanced rendering, is Windows-only.

reason.en: Free, open-source 3D modeling tool covering overlapping architectural/product-visualization use cases, though with a steeper general-purpose learning curve than SketchUp.
